nary_nodes.label: Wildfire erupts near Paris
evidence: Two firefighting planes were deployed to the Paris region Sunday after a large fire erupted south of the French capital, disrupting traffic during a busy summer travel weekend and piling more misery on a region sweltering through its latest heatwave.
The fire, which officials described as "very virulent" and of "exceptional scale," began late afternoon in the sprawling Fontainebleau forest about 40 miles south-east of the capital.
